headline: Not every baby gets the childhood they deserve
body: Some families are facing things no one should have to go through.

We know a lullaby can't fix that…
/but it can give families a little hope, comfort, safety./

Every time you buy an original lullaby,
_we create one for a family in need._
We can't change every circumstance a baby is born into, but we can bring a little more light into their world.
*So Moms and Dads, let's show the world what a bunch of parents with a little determination can do.*
ask: Hit all the buttons. Let's get this in front of as many parents as possible.
